hero.title: Jump to the exact moment a phrase is spoken
hero.subtitle: Paste a video link, enter a word or phrase, and jump straight to every matching moment.

features.title: Why JumpTo
features.exactDesc: We search the full transcript word by word, so you only get timestamps where the exact phrase appears — no fuzzy matches.
features.fastDesc: Transcripts are cached, so once a video has been transcribed the results come back in milliseconds.
features.jumpDesc: Every result links straight to the exact moment, so you watch the scene instead of scrubbing.

steps.title: How it works
steps.step2Desc: A single word or a full sentence.

footer.note: JumpTo — Find the moments that matter

form.title: Search a YouTube video for a word or phrase
form.keywordPlaceholder: e.g. never gonna give you up
form.pasteBlocked: Clipboard access isn’t available here. Click in the URL field and press Ctrl/⌘+V to paste — the text is already selected for you.
form.helperSpeed: Seconds if already transcribed — otherwise a few minutes.
form.helperPrivacy: Nothing is stored beyond the session cache.
form.helperDetails: JumpTo sends the link and phrase to our server to fetch the transcript and match it word for word. Transcripts are kept only in the session cache so repeat searches on the same video come back instantly, nothing is written to a database, and your search phrase is never stored.

status.title: Transcribing video
status.message: This can take a few minutes. We will show your results as soon as the transcript is ready.
